dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How can you be so relaxed?

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: I just finished a job that took half a year, so I'm taking it easy right now.

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: It's different these days. The Communications Office doesn't want to see a monopoly, and they want all Secure Transport Agencies to have jobs.

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: I used to get ten or so big jobs in six months, but nowadays I only get about two. The other eight've gone to other agencies.

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: But that's fine with me. I can still enjoy life without those eight jobs, but some might starve if they don't get their share.

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: When I was still a rookie, no one looked after me. I'll just think of this as a favor for the Communications Office and for the young ones.

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: If I keep taking their jobs, I might feel bad when I get old, you know?
